# #4486: Patch: follow-up to #4481 from the after-merge spot-check
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

<!-- jackioh-bot:spot-check-follow-up #4481 -->
The after-merge spot-check of #4481 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45005388686)) found 1 blocking problem(s) in the change as it merged (`1a51cecb6410`). `claude-1` (claude, `opus`, strong) reviewed it. #4481 stays merged: nothing is reverted, and this issue fixes what it found in a change of its own, from `main`.

## What to fix

- [ ] `crates/tools/src/sweep.rs:319`: Every sweep of record now plays twice as many games, but sweep.yml's time limits were not changed. A sweep over a whole set will run past the 350-minute job limit and deliver nothing, and per-card processes will hit the 45-minute SWEEP_CARD_MINUTES limit twice as early.
  Evidence: pass1() and pass2() now loop over SweepFace::ALL for every id and tier, and each face plays the full seeds_per_card and seeds_per_card_at_risk. training/history/sweep-2026-11-13.md shows the last whole-set sweep (166 cards, 3 lanes) took 07:59 to 13:17 UTC, about 318 minutes. .github/workflows/sweep.yml has `timeout-minutes: 350` (line 70), `SWEEP_LANES: "3"` and `SWEEP_CARD_MINUTES: "45"` (each card process is killed under `timeout` and left out of the report). At twice the games that run takes about 636 minutes, past both the job limit and hosted runners' 6-hour cap. sweep.yml runs by itself on every push to main that moves the AI's generation or ships a set. The PR's own 'Worth a second look' flags this as needing a person, but it merged without the workflow change. The fix is under .github/, so a person must do it (more SWEEP_LANES, a job split by face or by shard, a raised card limit), or a code-side alternative must be chosen, such as a CLI flag that lets the workflow run the faces as separate jobs.

## Done when

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).
